name: Corpse Stitcher
displayText: Pay 1 Energy and Exhaust — Remove a Unit card in your discard pile from the game. Create two Thrall Tokens.

notes: A card removed from the game is gone for good. It is not in any pile, nothing can target it, and no effect returns it.
The Exhaust cost is the limit on this ability: it can only be used again once this Unit is Ready.
The Tokens are created whether or not there was a Unit card to remove. The removal and the Tokens are two separate instructions, and one failing does not skip the other.
